text_block_list.text: All right!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
That was my best performance yet!
Someone tell
my heart to stop pounding!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Ugh! Dang it!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Dang it! Dang it! Dang it! Dang it!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Why'd ya lose, Tamamo?! Ya stupid
idiot,
pip-squeak, dummy!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: I'm not losin' next time... I'm gonna win!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Tamamo...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Seeing her so frustrated, I have to admit.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I've been running like an idiot.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Even when I lost, I never got that
frustrated. It
never hurt so much that I'd
be shaking.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I was too focused on what everyone was
saying
about me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I cared about it so much, I couldn't hear
the
sound of my own heart.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
How loud, how intense it is. How it's
been
screaming this entire time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Look, I...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I want to run.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I want to run! I want to run so bad! And...
and I
want to win!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I want to win! I don't want to lose to
anyone!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
As Голд Сити gazes out at the turf, the
excitement
of the race still coursing
through her veins...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: City...
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: Hey—wait, what? Why are you crying?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
To me, you'll always be the most
beautiful when
you're modeling. I still
stand by that.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
Standing in the spotlight, wowing all the

onlookers, you shine brighter than
anything else
in the world.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
But today, I have to admit... you were
incredibly...
incredibly beautiful out
there, too.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
I could feel your love for racing in every
step you
took. It exuded joy as pure as...
as light itself.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
It was the same light I saw when I first
scouted
you. Watching you sprint across
the turf took my
breath away.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
At work, you always trusted us adults
and did
everything we asked of you,
even when you didn't
want to.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
But racing is different, isn't it? It's
something you
wanted for yourself.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
I won't ask you to quit anymore. Run if
you want.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
But please, just don't get yourself hurt. I
don't
want any scratches on your face...
or your heart.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: If racing ever becomes something that hurts you, I will intervene.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: And you, Trainer... Please look after her.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
I swear she's like a helicopter mom. Like,
come
on—getting hurt's just part of life!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
She always acts like that, so how was I
supposed
to see... how much she really
cares?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Well, it can be hard to talk heart to heart.

text_block_list.text:
Don't think she'd want to hear that
coming from
you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean? ...Sigh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, about my next race. With the
Osaka Hai
and Tenno Sho behind us, I
guess it's gotta be...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Tamamo's gonna be there
too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Good. I'll make sure she can't ignore me
again.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: She will listen to what I have to say, no matter what.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
